judge: listening-judge (two independent model passes, keys withheld, per-pass per-row option shuffle)
note: Two independent blind passes over the authored N3 sokuji candidates; the burned rows were replaced by newly authored rows judged in its own packet under the same protocol (.cache/judge/n3-listening/rep). Packets were shuffled INDEPENDENTLY per row per pass, so the key never sat in the same option slot twice and position could not leak the answer. A row ships only when BOTH passes return PASS and both picks are the frozen key. N3 ships authored-only: JLPTSuccess ships listening at N5 only (LICENSE §29), so every N3 row is composed (LICENSE §30).

why: pass1 AMBIGUOUS: Both A (はい、田中で予約しています) and C (いいえ、予約しませんでした) answer ご予約はありますか at the same register; nothing tells which customer you are.
pass2 AMBIGUOUS: Same yes/no pair, both poles fully natural.
pass1 AMBIGUOUS: Both A (はい、静かにします) and B (すみません、話しすぎました) are complete, natural replies to 静かにしていただけますか; nothing decides between plain compliance and apology-with-reason.
pass2 AMBIGUOUS: Same pair survives the per-option test.
pass1 AMBIGUOUS: Both D (私は来週なら大丈夫です) and B (来週は会議がありますよ) are complete, natural answers to 来週でどうですか; accepting and countering are both standard.
pass2 AMBIGUOUS: Same accept/counter pair, both defensible.
pass1 AMBIGUOUS: Both C (はい、午後から雨だそうです) and B (いいえ、知りません) answer 明日の天気、調べましたか fully; nothing tells whether you checked.

pass1 AMBIGUOUS: Both B (週末は予約したほうがよさそうですよ) and C (いいえ、予約はいりません) answer the confirmation fully; which is true is not spoken.

pass1 AMBIGUOUS: Both C (おかげさまで、だいぶ良くなりました) and D (いいえ、直りませんでした) answer the tag question まだ悪そうですか at the same register; whether the PC recovered is not stated.
pass2 AMBIGUOUS: Same healed/not-healed pair, both natural.

pass1 UNFIT: The keyed option では、ごゆっくりお帰りください tells the speaker to go home slowly; it is said to a GUEST leaving, not to someone reporting they will be home late. The keyed option is not a natural reply.
pass2 UNFIT: Same register defect; the guest-leaving form cannot be the reply to a late-home report.
